book.name: Rom
book.title: Pol nainge tup nal lenge Rom

content: Got ŋasambe ŋoih miꞌmiꞌ kin nal lenge Israel

Ŋam de ma misilih tuꞌe leꞌe, taꞌe Got si nangange teket me lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge Juta lakai? Pakai supule! Ŋam topoꞌe, ŋam miyeꞌ Israel. Ŋam ŋambaih ende tikin Abraham, topoꞌe ŋam bamtihei ilyeh tikin Benjamin.

Got yukur nangange teket me lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge kitikin ŋaiye ŋendeheiyeh kin si nalaŋatme tinge. Yip ŋoiheryembe yilme wusyep bongol ŋaiye profet Elaija ŋaname Got me pupwa lenge Israel. Elaija ŋanange taꞌe leꞌe,

content.text: Lahmborenge! Lenge Israel si yongomb lenge profet nin lalme pe,
tinge si yule. Topoꞌe tinge yuluwau ŋeser hendeinge nin.
O ŋam ilyeh eꞌe ŋam marp pe,
tinge yahaiꞌ ŋam ŋaiye ka pumbe ma mule.

content: Got nungwisme wusyep kin taꞌe la? Kin ŋaname taꞌe leꞌe,

content.text: Lenge miyeꞌ syeꞌ ŋam tanam pe, wutuꞌ tinge tatame 7,000.
Tinge lenge miyeꞌ uku yukur yisarꞌe ŋihip mbep me got homboꞌe Bal
ŋaiye tinge yirisukwarme ti.

content: Ki ŋahilyeh taꞌe tukwini. Got ŋoih miꞌmiꞌ lenge mitiŋ syeꞌ Israel pe, kin si nalaŋatme tinge ŋaiye ka yurp tuꞌe lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge kitikin.
Got ŋoih miꞌmiꞌ me tinge pe, kin nalaŋatme tinge. Kin yukur ŋoiheryembe wah mune mune ŋaiye tinge yende no, kin nalaŋatme tinge, pakai. Kin nalaŋatme tinge pakaiye. Detale, kin ŋoih miꞌmiꞌ me tinge.

Taꞌe luku pe, ya mininge tuꞌe la? Ŋaimune ŋaiye lenge Israel yende wah nihe ŋaiye ka yambaꞌe pe, tinge yukur yambaꞌe. Got nalaŋatme lenge Israel syeꞌ pe, tinge yambaꞌe. O lenge mitiŋ wula wula pe, ŋoihmbwaip tinge si susukut miꞌe.
Wusyep ŋaiye sai nato Tup tikin Got ŋanange taꞌe leꞌe,

content.text: Got si ŋende ŋoihmbwaip tinge si bermbur.
Kin ŋende ŋembep tinge si yepelmbe pe,
yukur ka se yetekeꞌe ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe,
topoꞌe mungwim tinge si kwote pe,
yukur ka yusyunde wusyep.
Tinge yarp taꞌe luku yate jere tukwini.

content: Dewit plihe ŋanange wusyep ilyeh uku taꞌe leꞌe,

content.text: Ŋupe ŋaiye ka juhilyeh yono ŋai embere pe,
ŋup pupwa ka ende yumbune tinge.
Ka tuꞌe ŋaiye ni nenge tem narpe hroꞌ,
topoꞌe ka tuꞌe ŋeheh ende ŋaiye ka tumbe yi juh no,
ŋeser ka gere ŋihip tinge pe, ka yambaꞌe yitini pupwa tinge.
Ka ende ŋembep tinge ka tingir pe, yukur ka plihe yetekeꞌe ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe.
Hwap ka ende lupu ŋaiye nal teket tinge luku ka ŋataiꞌ pe, ka gih gih.

content: Got nungwisme lenge haiten miyeꞌ tuweinge

Taꞌe luku pe, ŋam de ma misilih tuꞌe leꞌe: Ŋupe ŋaiye lenge Israel tambe ya yoto hwap pe, tinge talai buryehme lakai? Pakai. Tinge yaŋaꞌe teket me Got, kut Got nungwisme lenge haiten miyeꞌ tuweinge. Got ŋasande ŋaiye lenge Israel miyeꞌ tuweinge ka yetekeꞌe ŋaimune bwore bwore ŋaiye Got nungwisme lenge haiten miyeꞌ tuweinge pe, lenge Israel ka ŋoihmbwaip pupwa me tinge, topoꞌe ka ternenge sisingir me ŋai uku.

Ŋupe ŋaiye lenge Israel miyeꞌ tuweinge yasme yaŋah bwore tikin Got ya yoto yende hwap pe, Got nangange ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe bwore bwore nal lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme ŋaiye yarp kekep. Topoꞌe lenge Israel yaŋaꞌe teket yalme Got pe, Got nangange ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe bwore bwore nalme lenge haiten miyeꞌ tuweinge. Taꞌe luku pe, ŋaiye lenge Israel miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme ka plihe yaŋaꞌe ŋoihmbwaip tinge yilme Got pe, kin se ka uwilꞌe ŋoih miꞌmiꞌ embere kin el lenge mitiŋ lalme.
Ŋam manange wusyep eꞌe malme yip lenge haiten miyeꞌ tuweinge. Got si nalaŋatme ŋam taꞌe aposel ŋaiye ma mende wah guh bumbe me yip haiten pe, ŋam hriphrip ŋaiye ma mende wah uku.
Ŋam ŋoiheryembe taꞌe leꞌe, ŋam da mahraꞌe ŋoihmbwaip lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋam Juta ŋaiye ternenge sisingir me yip no, syeꞌ tinge, ŋoihmbwaip tinge ka teŋeime Krais pe, Got ka ungwisme tinge.

Ŋupe ŋaiye Got ginyen lenge Juta miyeꞌ tuweinge pe, Got bunjenge lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge kekep ŋaiye somohon yende wachaihme kin pe, tinge ŋemei kin. Taꞌe luku pe, ŋaiye Got ka ungwisme lenge Israel pe, poi ya sisyeme nange Got se ka ahraꞌe lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye somohon yule pe, ka plihe tuhur.
Ŋaiye Abraham topoꞌe lenge mwan kaꞌ lenge Juta yarp bwore bwarme pe, lenge ŋambaih talah tinge topoꞌe se ka yurp bwore bwarme. O ŋaiye lou nam uku bwore bwarme pe, lou lombo topoꞌe bwore bwarme.

Kom lou lombo syeꞌ tikin lou olip ŋaiye bwore luku pe, tinge miyeꞌ syeꞌ Juta, Got si ŋotombo ŋiche nal, kut kin plihe nambaꞌe lou lombo tikin olip pupwa ŋaiye gere sai sipsyap nate neŋelꞌe nal. Yip lenge haiten miyeꞌ tuweinge pe, yip taꞌe lou olip pupwa ŋaiye gere sai sipsyap. Pe tukwini yip yambaꞌe ŋom bwore natme lou tehei ŋaiye lou olip bwore tikin Got ŋahilyeh taꞌe lou lombo syeꞌ ŋaiye yambaꞌe pe, pa yurp bwore.

Taꞌe luku pe, yip yukur pa ŋoiheryembe nange yip si bwore miꞌ supule yengelyembe lenge lou lombo tikin lou orope olip uku. Yukur pa tengelyem no, pa ŋoiheryembe tuꞌe liki, na pakai! Yip lou lombo leꞌe. Lou lombo yukur kete kekep ŋom no, ki naŋaꞌe nalme lou orope, topoꞌe lou nam, pakai. Lou nam kete ŋom gah kekep ti, ki naŋaꞌe nalme lou orope topoꞌe lombo.
Kom yip pa yininge tuꞌe leꞌe, “Got ŋotombo lenge lou lombo luku ŋiche nal. Detale, kin plihe nambaꞌe poi na neŋelꞌe nanah luh tinge.”

Luku ki bwore mise. Lenge lou lombo luku pe, lenge Juta miyeꞌ tuweinge. Tehei kin taꞌe leꞌe, ŋoihmbwaip tinge yukur teŋeime Got pe, kin ŋotombo tinge ŋiche nal. Kom yip pe, ŋoihmbwaip yip teŋeime kin pe, yip yarp bwore. Taꞌe luku pe, yip ŋoiheryembe bworerme. Ŋoihme ŋaiye pa yahraꞌe naŋ yip tip. Yip pa hiꞌjirnge pe, pa yurp ŋumwaiye.
Te ŋoiheryembe! Somohon yukur Got nasme lou lombo syeꞌ lenge Juta ki sai, pakai. Taꞌe luku pe, ŋaiye yip pa yende bwiliꞌe bwulaꞌe yengelyembe wusyep Got pe, yukur ka se enge syep ember me yip, pakai.

Leꞌe ya metekeꞌe Got kin miyeꞌ taꞌe la? Kin Got ŋaiye pasam poi ŋoihmbwaip ŋumwaiye topoꞌe ŋoihmbwaip gamare. Kin nangange nihe syohe nalme lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge luku ŋaiye yengelyembe wusyep kin. Kom lahmende miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye tongorꞌ yal ŋoihmbwaip ŋumwaiye tikin Got pe, kin nangange ŋoihmbwaip bwore bwore nalme tinge. O ŋaiye yukur pa yaŋaꞌe ŋoihmbwaip yip yilme kin pe, se ka otombo yip iche el.
Topoꞌe ŋaiye lenge Juta miyeꞌ tuweinge ka plihe yimbilme ŋoihmbwaip yilme Got pe, kin se ka plihe ambaꞌe tinge eŋelꞌe el lou orope luku. Kin ilyeh bongol tatame ŋaiye ka ende ŋai uku.

Yip haiten, yip sisyeme, somohon yip yarp taꞌe lou lombo tikin lou olip ŋaiye gere sai nal syipsyap tinginde. Kom Got kin ŋotombo yip pe, kin neŋelꞌe yip nal lou olip ŋaiye sai wah. Lou olip luku yukur yip iki, pakai. Taꞌe luku pe, ŋam mana yip. Got se ka plihe ambaꞌe lou lombo tikin Juta, ŋaiye lou olip lombo tikin wah uku ŋaiye somohon kin ŋotombo ŋiche nal uku plihe eŋelꞌe el luh kitikin ŋaiye somohon sai.
Got ŋasambe ŋoihmbwaip ŋumwaiye kin nal lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme

Lenge toꞌ tatai ŋam, ŋam masande ŋaiye yip pa sisyeme wusyep tase ende leꞌe. Ŋaiye pa sisyeme wusyep eꞌe bworerme pe, yukur pa se plihe ŋoiheryembe yip tip nange yip si sisyeme ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme. Ŋoihmbwaip syeꞌ lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge Juta si susukut pe, ka yurp tuꞌe luku yil tutume ŋupe ŋaiye namba lenge haiten miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye ka yutme Krais pe, ka usungurhme namba ŋaiye Got si nalaŋatme tinge.
Pe luku yaŋah ŋaiye Got ka ungwisme lenge Israel. Ki gande wusyep ŋaiye sai nato Tup tikin Got ŋanange taꞌe leꞌe,

content.text: Miyeꞌ nungwisme ŋaiye ka ot no, ka ungwisme lenge Israel pe,
ka ose Jerusalem ot.
Kin ka ende lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme
ŋaiye bamtihei tikin Jekop ka yusme yaŋah
ŋaiye yende bwiliꞌe bwulaꞌe yengelyembe wusyep Got.
Ŋam ma mupwaiꞌe kontrak eꞌe topoꞌe tinge,
ŋaiye ma mongohe ŋoihmbwaip pupwa tinge.

content: Lenge Israel yaŋaꞌe teket me wusyep bwore mise tikin Jisas pe, tinge yende wachaihme Got. Pe luku ki nungwisme yip lenge haiten miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye yate sisyeme Got. Kom somohonme Got si nalaŋatme tinge ŋaiye ka yurp tuꞌe lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge kitikin. Got ŋende gande wusyep tupwaiꞌ bongol kin ŋaiye kin nupwaiꞌe topoꞌe Abraham, Aisak topoꞌe Jekop.
Got yukur tatame ka se bunjenge ŋoihmbwaip kin me lahmende ŋaiye kin nalaŋatme, topoꞌe kin naŋaꞌe ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe bwore bwore kin nalme tinge.

Somohon yip lenge haiten miyeꞌ tuweinge pe, yip yende bwiliꞌe bwulaꞌe yengelyembe wusyep Got. Kom tukwini pe, Got si ŋoihginirme yip. Detale, lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge Juta si yende bwiliꞌe bwulaꞌe yengelyembe wusyep Got.

Topoꞌe tukwini ŋahilyeh uku pe, lenge Juta miyeꞌ tuweinge si yende bwiliꞌe bwulaꞌe yengelyembe wusyep tikin Got. Kom ŋup ende pe, tinge Juta topoꞌe se ka yambaꞌe ŋoihginir tikin Got. Detale, Got kin si ŋoihginirme yip.

Tehei ŋaiye lenge miyeꞌ lalme yarp ya yoto mwahupwaiꞌe me hwap pupwa pe, tinge yende bwiliꞌe bwulaꞌe yengelyembe wusyep Got. Kin nasme tinge yende taꞌe luku no, mindemboi ka asamb lenge ŋoihmbwaip ŋumwaiye kin elme tinge lalme.
Poi ya mahraꞌe naŋ tikin Got

content.text: Hei, Got kin papararme sande tekeꞌe,
topoꞌe ŋoihmbwaip bwore bwore kin gah gah nal taꞌe ŋaiye ŋoloh pinip.
Poi miyeꞌ yukur tatame ŋaiye ya se metekeꞌe sisyeme
ŋoihmbwaip tase kin lalme.
Topoꞌe poi yukur tatame ya se gunde yaŋah kin lalme.
Wusyep ŋaiye sai nato Tup tikin Got ŋanange taꞌe leꞌe,
Lahmende tatame ka se sisyeme ŋoihmbwaip tikin Got?
Lahmende tatame ka se aŋaꞌe ŋoihmbwaip ungwisme kin?
Topoꞌe lahmende si naŋaꞌe ŋaimune nalme Got yer ti,
Got se ka plihe ungwisme ŋai uku otme kin?

content: Ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme ŋaiye tukwini sai eꞌe pe, Got kin ŋende. Kin tehei me ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme. Ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme leꞌe pe, ŋai kitikin. Poi ya mirisukwarme mahraꞌe naŋ kin nye nyermbe. Bwore mise.

footnotes.text: 11.16 Lou nam tinge mwan kaꞌ lenge Juta pe, lou lombo tinge ŋambaih talah.
